snippet.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within - Official Pre-Alpha Gameplay Teaser Trailer | The MIX Fall Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Slain 2: The Beast Within teaser trailer for this gothic hack-and-slash game where steel and savagery collide. The Slain 2: The Beast Within teaser trailers shows brutal pre-alpha gameplay, combat, and more. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world. The time for hesitation is over. The quest begins now. Akran’s fate - and the fate of the kingdom - rests in your hands in Slain 2: The Beast Within. Slain 2: The Beast Within will be available on PC.
